text: Welcome to Day 1! Hi, I’m Luna 🐱.
Are you ready for a magical adventure with Coach Max?
Let’s do a fun breathing exercise together.
Breathe in... and breathe out... Like a calm monkey 🐵.
Let’s count from 1 to 10 with Benny 🐶!
One... Two... Three... Four... Five... Six... Seven... Eight... Nine... Ten!
Can you show it with your fingers?
Let’s try a funny rhyme together!
Benny the dog likes to jog, he chases a cat and jumps over a log!
Say it fast: jog, log, dog, cat!
I make a ‘meow’ sound and love to climb. Who am I?
Once upon a time, Luna the cat and Benny the dog went on a treasure hunt.
They found a sparkling sticker at the end – just for you!
See you tomorrow for a new adventure!
